vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-45831
vulnerability.description: ChromaDB's SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider does not check which tenant, database, or collection a permission applies to.

statements.impact_statement: chromadb is used only as an embedded, file-backed store: mcp_server/tools/cve_search.py builds a chromadb.PersistentClient inside the MCP server process, and the deployment runs no ChromaDB service at all (docker-compose ships mcp-server, agent-api, seed-job, frontend and jaeger). The flaw lives in chromadb.auth.simple_rbac_authz.SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider, which ChromaDB instantiates only when a server is configured with chroma_server_authz_provider. This deployment sets no authorization provider and starts no server, so the class is never instantiated: the vulnerable code ships inside the installed package but sits outside every execution path. No patched chromadb release exists (1.5.9 is still the latest on PyPI as of 2026-09-21), so this statement is revisited when a fixed version ships.
